title: Hom complex of complexes of sheaves of modules
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and $\mathcal L^\bullet,\mathcal M^\bullet$ cochain complexes of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. The *Hom complex* $\mathcal Hom^\bullet(\mathcal L^\bullet,\mathcal M^\bullet)$ is the cochain complex of $\mathcal O$-modules with terms

$$
 \mathcal Hom^n(\mathcal L^\bullet,\mathcal M^\bullet)=\prod_{p\in\mathbf Z}\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal L^p,\mathcal M^{p+n}),
$$

the product taken in the category of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (which has all products, computed sectionwise) of the sheaf Hom modules [def-pur-sheaf-hom]; a section over $U$ is a family $f=(f^p)_p$ of $\mathcal O|_U$-linear maps $f^p:\mathcal L^p|_U\to\mathcal M^{p+n}|_U$, i.e. an $\mathcal O|_U$-linear map of graded modules homogeneous of degree $n$. The differential $d^n:\mathcal Hom^n\to\mathcal Hom^{n+1}$ is

$$
 d(f)=d_{\mathcal M}\circ f-(-1)^n f\circ d_{\mathcal L},\qquad\text{i.e. } d(f)^p=d_{\mathcal M}^{p+n}\circ f^p-(-1)^n f^{p+1}\circ d_{\mathcal L}^p ,
$$

an $\mathcal O$-linear map of sheaves compatible with restriction, and $d^{n+1}\circ d^n=0$ (expanding, $d(d(f))=d_{\mathcal M}d_{\mathcal M}f-(-1)^{n}d_{\mathcal M}fd_{\mathcal L}-(-1)^{n+1}d_{\mathcal M}fd_{\mathcal L}+(-1)^{n+1}(-1)^n f d_{\mathcal L}d_{\mathcal L}=0$). The construction is functorial: contravariant in $\mathcal L^\bullet$ and covariant in $\mathcal M^\bullet$, by composing componentwise with morphisms of complexes.
